caption:
Indonesia arrests three over alleged Dian Swastatika share manipulation

The arrests follow MSCI's threat to downgrade the country to standalone market status. The suspects allegedly manipulated trading volumes, helping the stock meet criteria for inclusion in MSCI indexes. An Indonesian police official announced the arrests.

Reported by Financial Times; The Straits Times.
